title: Leading mode
nonlocal: This conference has no local agenda.
fallback: The configured language is unavailable. This script uses English.
greeting: Dear sisters, brothers, friends and visitors, welcome to our sacrament meeting.
fastGreeting: Dear sisters, brothers, friends and visitors, welcome to our fast and testimony meeting.
presiding: We are pleased to welcome {people}, presiding today.
music_conductor: Our music leadership is provided by {people}.
closingHymn: We will close our meeting by singing {hymn}.
pair: We will begin by singing {hymn}, after which {people} will offer the opening prayer.
closingPair: We will close with {hymn}, after which {people} will offer the closing prayer.
sacramentHymn: We will prepare for the sacrament by singing {hymn}. After the hymn, priesthood holders will bless and pass the sacrament.
blessingCue: Pause while the sacrament is blessed.
passingCue: Pause until the sacrament has been passed.
sacramentThanks: Thank you for your reverence, and to those who prepared, blessed and passed the sacrament.
talkThanks: Thank you, {people}, for the address and testimony.
talksThanks: Thank you, {people}, for the addresses and testimonies.
musical_number: We will now hear a musical number by {people}.
primary_presentation: We will now enjoy the children’s presentation.
presentationThanks: Thank you to the children and all who helped with the presentation.
testimony: We now invite you to share your testimonies of Jesus Christ and His gospel.
testimonyThanks: Thank you for sharing your testimonies.
calling_sustain: We propose that {people} be sustained in the following calling: {detail}. Those in favor of supporting this person may show it by raising the hand.
opposed: Those opposed, if any, may show it.
calling_release: With sincere appreciation for the service given, we propose that {people} be released from the following calling: {detail}. Those wishing to express their thanks may show it by raising the hand.
priesthood_aaronic_inform: We inform you that {people} has been called to the following assignment: {detail}. This calling was sustained in the appropriate quorum. We thank this person for the willingness to serve and invite your support.
member_welcome: We welcome {people} as a new member of our ward. Please stand. Those who welcome this person and are willing to offer support may show it by raising the hand.
childBaptism: We recognize {people}, who has been baptized and confirmed a member of The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints. We rejoice in this decision and offer our support.
convert_confirmation: We invite {people} forward for confirmation as a member of The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints and the gift of the Holy Ghost.
child_naming_blessing: We invite those participating in the naming and blessing of {people} to come forward.
childBlessingCue: Pause for the naming and blessing.
